name: Heritage Classic 38
description: The Heritage Classic 38 distils more than a century of Swiss watchmaking into a restrained three-hand dress watch. Its ivory lacquer dial is applied by hand, and the in-house automatic calibre is finished with Côtes de Genève visible through the sapphire case back.
highlights: 38mm case for an understated wrist presence

name: Chronomaster Automatic
description: A column-wheel chronograph with an unmistakable architectural dial. Two tone-on-tone sub-dials and a tachymeter scale frame a movement that beats at 28,800 vibrations per hour. Measured, precise and quietly confident.

name: Marina Diver 300
description: Engineered for the deep and refined for the desk. A 300-metre diver with a ceramic bezel, screw-down crown and a lumed dial that stays legible in the murkiest water.

name: Sovereign Moonphase
description: A moonphase complication rendered in enamel and gold. The Sovereign pairs an astronomical display with a hand-guilloché dial, a quietly extraordinary piece for those who read the sky as well as the time.

name: Aurelia Rosé 34
description: Feminine, luminous and precise. The Aurelia Rosé pairs a mother-of-pearl dial with a rose gold case and a slender leather strap. A watch designed to be worn close and noticed quietly.

name: Regent Chronograph
description: An English sporting chronograph with a warm champagne dial and vintage-inspired proportions. Understated hardware, an oversized crown, and a case profile that slips beneath a cuff.

specs.label: Strap
specs.value: Tan calf leather with pin buckle

name: Celestia Diamond 32
description: The Celestia sets sixty brilliant-cut diamonds into a snow-set bezel that catches every flicker of light. Beneath it, a silvered dial and a whisper-thin automatic movement keep time with equal grace.

name: Nocturne Skeleton
description: Every bridge is chamfered by hand and every wheel left exposed. The Nocturne is an open-worked automatic that turns a movement into architecture, presented behind sapphire on both sides.

name: Solstice GMT
description: A traveller’s companion with a second time zone and a 24-hour chapter ring in sapphire blue. The jumping local hour makes resetting the time across borders effortless.
highlights: True GMT with jumping local hour

name: Aeris Aviator
description: A cockpit instrument reimagined for the wrist. High-contrast Arabic numerals, an oversize onion crown and an anti-magnetic movement keep the Aeris legible and reliable at altitude.

name: Lumen Slim Dress
description: A slim, Bauhaus-inspired dress watch with a matte midnight dial and a single, perfect date window. At 8.2mm it disappears under a shirt cuff and reappears only when you need it.

specs.label: Dial
specs.value: Matte midnight blue with applied indices

name: Tide Diver GMT
description: A dive watch that also keeps a second time zone. The ceramic bezel and 300-metre rating handle the water; the GMT hand handles the itinerary.

name: Fjord Diver 42
description: Built for cold water and long days. The Fjord pairs a brushed steel case with a glacier dial and a rubber strap engineered to stay supple in sub-zero conditions.

name: Glacier Sport Chrono
description: A quartz-accurate sports chronograph with a high-contrast panda dial and a tachymeter scale. Rugged, readable, and ready for the weekend.

name: Aurora Automatic 39
description: An entry into mechanical watchmaking that compromises nothing on finish. A green sunray dial, applied numerals, and a reliable automatic movement at an honest price.

name: Parisian Rosé 30
description: A jewel of a watch from the Paris atelier. The Parisian Rosé fits a rose-gold case, a guilloché dial and a cabochon crown onto a 30mm canvas. Pure, precise and unmistakably French.

name: Grand Complication
description: The atelier’s masterwork: a perpetual calendar, minute repeater and tourbillon united in a single movement, cased in platinum and limited to twenty-five pieces worldwide. A collector’s horological statement.

name: Étoile Diamond
description: A constellation set in diamonds around a deep midnight dial. The Étoile scatters brilliant-cut stones across the bezel and lugs, mirroring a clear winter sky.

name: Ivory Dress 36
description: A softly rounded dress watch with an ivory lacquer dial and a warm gold-tone case. The Ivory Dress 36 is the quiet answer to everyday elegance.

name: Monarch Perpetual
description: A perpetual calendar that will not need a correction until the year 2100. The Monarch displays day, date, month and moonphase with English restraint and Swiss precision.

name: WG-01 Heritage Auto
description: The first piece from our own maison. The WG-01 pairs a hand-grained silver sunray dial with the in-house WG-2101 automatic calibre, finished with perlage and assembled in Geneva. Every case back is individually engraved with its edition number.
highlights: Numbered case back, engraved by hand

name: WG-02 Chronosport 42
description: Our sports chronograph, built around a column-wheel WG-440 calibre with a vertical clutch. The matte ceramic bezel, waffle-style pushers and tachymeter scale make it the sharpest tool we have ever cased.

name: WG-03 Luna 34
description: A dress watch for her, in our own atelier. The WG-03 sets a mother-of-pearl dial beneath slender dauphine hands, carried on a Milanese mesh bracelet woven in Italy. Quietly radiant, every single day.
